summary: Banked Fire stores failed candidate dispatches as time-limited skips and filters them out of the next drain.

paragraphs.text: add_skip appends a row with source, reason and an expiry, then writes the whole file through a temporary file and replaces the original.
Each row records the reason, cut to 200 characters, and the time the skip was added.
A skip lasts seven days unless the caller passes another value.
candidate_exclusions keeps only rows whose expiry is later than the current time.
Skips are also pruned when the process restarts.
